basics.name: Anilkumar U K
basics.summary: I build practical software — an EdTech platform, a ticket-booking system — and I care about the part users actually touch. Currently in my third year at Alliance University, learning fast and shipping real projects.

availability.note: Open to internships & junior developer roles

about.heading: Turning ideas into
about.body: B.Tech Computer Science and Engineering student at Alliance University with a growing focus on full-stack development and AI-enabled applications. Hands-on experience building practical projects including an online movie ticket booking system and iBuddie, an EdTech platform. Eager to build useful products, strengthen engineering skills, and contribute to a software development team.

projects.title: iBuddie
projects.subtitle: EdTech platform · personal · full stack + AI
projects.description: An EdTech platform built around one question: what actually helps a student study? Digital and AI-assisted study features, student-oriented learning workflows, and a modern web interface that stays out of the way.

projects.title: Movie Ticket Booking
projects.subtitle: Academic project · Python
projects.description: An end-to-end booking flow in Python: browse what's playing, check seat availability, hold a selection and confirm it. Written to practise clean program structure and the user interaction around a transaction.
